== Documentation ==
The documentation comments for this script come from the <code>DefaultPlaySoundAndImodOnEffectStart.psc</code> source file.

<source>
For playing an imagespace, a sound, or both when Potions are used, typically when these should be played only once the Data Menu is closed.
</source>
